span.p:
web
nginx:alpine · Nginx :80
SPA compilada + proxy /api y /uploads
resolver 127.0.0.11 · healthcheck wget /
restart: unless-stopped

span.p:
api
node:22-alpine · Express :3001
usuario node · healthcheck /api/health
FRONTEND_URL para CORS
restart: unless-stopped

migrate
misma imagen que api
one-shot: node dist/migrations/cli.js
restart: no

compose.yml - local/staging

APP_VERSION=local
sin logging explicito

logging json-file 10m x 3
